limitations: IJCNN1 is the released repository entrypoint default but is not one of the six datasets reported in the paper's Table 2.
Only prior 0.2 is executable under the released 3,000-row holdout protocol for the verified complete IJCNN1 file.
The clean-room optimizer uses 0.5 * lambda * ||b||^2 to make the released objective consistent with its supplied gradient.
densratio center selection is deterministically seeded per trial instead of inheriting the released script's process-global RNG state after PUSB fitting.
Three feasible seeds are configured as an execution tranche; the paper's 100 repetitions remain incomplete.
Results remain paper_claim=false; they audit the repository's IJCNN1 extension rather than reproduce Table 2.
